This SDS image looks very similar to the test image — yellow interveinal areas with green veins and pinkish/purplish blotches. Strong match. Let me continue exploring other candidates before confirming.

BSR shows green veins with interveinal necrosis — similar pattern but more advanced. Let me check remaining candidates.

- **Sudden_death_syndrome** (Dise_251): Yellow interveinal areas with green veins and pinkish/purplish blotches — **best visual match** to test image

- All others (Frogeye, Rust, Cercospora, Bacterial diseases, etc.) show discrete spots or different patterns that don't match the widespread interveinal mottling in the test

The test image shows the classic SDS pattern: yellow-green interveinal chlorosis with green veins remaining and pinkish-reddish necrotic patches developing between veins — exactly matching Soybean_Dise_251.
